testHarnessDefects.symptom: The live TCP port allocator passed python -c source to SSH as separate unquoted remote-shell fragments.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Send one shell-quoted remote command and assert the exact SSH argv shape.
testHarnessDefects.regression: remote port allocation sends one shell-quoted command to SSH

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The live ACP canary required cwd and sentinel digest in one completed tool call even though real agents may establish them across multiple completed calls.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Evaluate the union of completed tool evidence while retaining the withheld digest and marker-only rejection.
testHarnessDefects.regression: project evidence may be established across multiple completed tool calls

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The installed terminal fixture treated one signal wait as its whole lifecycle, so a resize signal could terminate it before the Ctrl-C oracle.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Keep the fixture in a signal wait loop until the explicit interrupt handler terminates it.
testHarnessDefects.regression: installed terminal survives resize, observes changed columns, and then records the explicit interrupt

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The fake adapter returned an empty object for threads, which is not a valid DAP ThreadsResponse and produced an avoidable client parse error.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Return the protocol-valid empty threads list and retain the full initialize/launch/configure/threads/terminate assertion.
testHarnessDefects.regression: installed TCP DAP fixture returns threads: [] and the assembled journey has no invalid-response error

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The resize oracle required the first and last width to differ, even though legitimate intermediate resize activity can return to the original width.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Persist all observed widths and require at least two distinct values plus an explicit interrupt.
testHarnessDefects.regression: terminal receipt records observedColumns with at least two distinct widths

testHarnessDefects.symptom: Authorizing the synthetic .envrc after Zed opened the project left the remote directory environment cached without the fixture values.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Authorize the exact fixture directory before opening the installed app and verify both directory and surface environment hashes.
testHarnessDefects.regression: prepare phase performs exact direnv allow before launch and task/terminal receipts match the authorized environment

testHarnessDefects.symptom: The remote cleanup census matched its own Python/SSH ancestor command lines because they contained fixture paths and script names.
testHarnessDefects.fix: Exclude the observer's reuse-safe ancestor identities while continuing to report matching sibling and descendant processes.
testHarnessDefects.regression: Linux procfs fixture excludes observer ancestry but detects live non-ancestor residue

negativeControl.interpretation: Expected fail-closed safety behavior, not a route-health acceptance result.
